items.name: b-shieldbearer-lock-shields
items.subject: LOCK SHIELDS, the Shieldbearer braces in place: a huge riveted royal-blue tower shield with a steel boss seen head-on, planted firmly into the ground with its bottom edge sunk in, enemy arrows and bolts shattering and glancing off its face in bright white sparks. Energy colour: cold steel-blue and white.

items.name: b-breacher-charge
items.subject: BREACHER CHARGE: the Breacher's spinning steel siege drill bursts diagonally through a cracking wall of dark stone toward the viewer, chunks of rock and orange sparks flying, motion blur on the drill's spiral. Energy colour: hot orange sparks.

items.name: b-arcwright-arc
items.subject: ARC DISCHARGE, the Arcwright's chain arc: close-up of the coiled brass tip of its coil lance (lower left) releasing a crackling ball of violet lightning that splits into two forked bolts streaking to the upper right. Energy colour: violet and electric white.

items.name: b-mender-patch
items.subject: FIELD PATCH, the Mender heals a beetle: a cracked black chitin shoulder plate being mended by a brass patch freshly riveted over the crack, a soft warm golden healing glow spreading from the patch, a brass syringe-gun nozzle at the edge. Energy colour: warm gold.

items.name: b-mender-repair
items.subject: WELD REPAIR, the Mender repairs machines: a brass welding torch arm (upper left) welding a seam in a dented royal-blue riveted machine plate, a shower of bright orange-white sparks, the weld line glowing hot. Energy colour: bright orange-white sparks.

items.name: b-warden-field
items.subject: BARRIER FIELD, the Warden's directional shield: a curved translucent violet energy pane held in a brass frame on two prongs, seen from the front-left, enemy arrows and bolts striking it and stopping dead in rippling rings of violet light. Energy colour: violet and soft blue.

items.name: b-research-pressure-mains
items.subject: PRESSURE MAINS (the beetles' substance network reaches further): a thick brass pipe junction with a big red-brass valve wheel and a pressure gauge, a violet glass sight-tube in the pipe where substance glows, pipes leading away in three directions.

items.name: b-research-weapon-edges-1
items.subject: WEAPON EDGES I (melee weapons, tier one of three): a beetle piston-hammer head of plain dark iron with a freshly ground bright steel striking edge, simple and heavy.

items.name: b-research-weapon-edges-2
items.subject: WEAPON EDGES II (melee weapons, tier two of three): the same beetle piston-hammer head now of hardened polished steel banded with brass, its striking edge honed and gleaming.

items.name: b-research-weapon-edges-3
items.subject: WEAPON EDGES III (melee weapons, tier three of three): the masterwork beetle piston-hammer head, polished steel and ornate brass, with a violet substance-glass piston core glowing in its centre, its edge gleaming.

items.name: b-research-bolt-calibre-1
items.subject: BOLT CALIBRE I (ranged weapons, tier one of three): three plain dark-iron repeater bolts lying fanned out, thick and blunt-tipped.

items.name: b-research-bolt-calibre-2
items.subject: BOLT CALIBRE II (ranged weapons, tier two of three): three larger repeater bolts with brass jackets and sharpened steel tips, fanned out.

items.name: b-research-bolt-calibre-3
items.subject: BOLT CALIBRE III (ranged weapons, tier three of three): three heavy brass-jacketed repeater bolts fanned out, each with a small violet substance-glass capsule behind its hardened steel tip, glowing.

items.name: b-research-plating-1
items.subject: PLATING I (armour, tier one of three): one thick curved shoulder plate of plain dark riveted iron with a strip of royal-blue paint.

items.name: b-research-plating-2
items.subject: PLATING II (armour, tier two of three): one thick curved royal-blue armour plate (a shoulder pauldron) of riveted dark steel with polished brass edging and heavy brass rivets.

items.name: b-research-plating-3
items.subject: PLATING III (armour, tier three of three): one massive layered royal-blue armour pauldron, double plates with ornate brass edging and a small round violet substance-glass stud glowing in its centre.

items.name: b-research-interlocking-shields
items.subject: INTERLOCKING SHIELDS (Lock Shields gives more armour): two riveted royal-blue tower shields with steel bosses standing side by side, their edges locked together by heavy brass clamps.

items.name: b-research-drum-magazines
items.subject: DRUM MAGAZINES (Bolters fire faster): a big round brass drum magazine with a royal-blue band, a belt of bolts feeding out of it, a pressure line attached.

items.name: b-research-heavy-pistons
items.subject: HEAVY PISTONS (the Breacher charges more often): a massive polished steel piston rod driving out of a brass cylinder with heavy bolts, a puff of white steam escaping at the seal.

items.name: b-research-specialist-adept
items.subject: SPECIALIST TRAINING: ADEPT (unlocks the specialists' second abilities): a brass instrument case opened, holding a set of calipers, a small coil and one sealed violet substance-glass vial in a padded slot.

items.name: b-research-specialist-master
items.subject: SPECIALIST TRAINING: MASTER: an ornate brass astrolabe-like regulator of nested rings and gears around a glowing violet substance-glass sphere at its centre, perfectly contained.

items.name: b-research-fragmentation-shells
items.subject: FRAGMENTATION SHELLS (the Bombard's blast spreads wider): a fat round mortar shell of segmented dark iron with deep grooves and a brass fuse cap, standing upright, a faint orange glow from the fuse.

items.name: b-research-riveted-hulls-1
items.subject: RIVETED HULLS I (machines gain health, tier one of two): a curved section of a machine's hull, a royal-blue riveted steel plate with a row of big iron rivets.

items.name: b-research-riveted-hulls-2
items.subject: RIVETED HULLS II (machines gain health, tier two of two): a curved section of a machine's hull with a second thick plate layered over the first, double rows of big brass rivets and brass edging.

items.name: b-research-afterburners
items.subject: AFTERBURNERS (the Steamwing flies faster): a brass boiler exhaust nozzle seen from behind at an angle, blasting a bright jet of blue-violet substance exhaust and white steam.

items.name: b-research-arc-tower
items.subject: ARC TOWER (the Hornwatch becomes a substance coil with chain lightning): a tall brass coil spire with stacked copper rings and a violet glass core, violet arcs crackling from its tip, rising between two curved black horns.

items.name: resource-amber
items.subject: AMBER, the game's main resource: a cluster of three or four big smooth, glossy, translucent amber nuggets of warm honey-orange, glowing softly from within like hardened tree resin, a tiny trapped air bubble in one. Warm orange and gold only.
